'''Michael Barrett Woodroofe''' (March 17, 1940 – February 22, 2022) was an American [[Probability theory|probabilist]] and [[statistician]].  He was a [[professor]] of [[statistics]] and of [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Michigan]], where he was the [[Leonard Jimmie Savage|Leonard J. Savage]] Professor until his retirement.  He was noted for his work in [[sequential analysis]] and nonlinear renewal theory, in [[Central Limit Theorem|central limit]] theory, and in [[Nonparametric statistics|nonparametric inference]] with shape constraints.

==Education and career==
Woodroofe was born in [[Corvallis, Oregon|Corvallis]], [[Oregon]], and grew up in nearby [[Athena, Oregon]].<ref name=conversations/>  He received his [[Bachelor of Science]] in mathematics from [[Stanford University]] in 1962.  He went on to the [[University of Oregon]] for his masters and PhD in mathematics, which he completed in 1965.<ref name=conversations /><ref name=lectureseries /><ref name=cv />

After his PhD, he spent a brief stint as an assistant professor at [[Carnegie Mellon University]], before moving to the [[University of Michigan]] in 1968.  He spent the rest of his career at Michigan, where he was a founding member of the statistics department.  In 1994 he was named the Leonard J. Savage Professor, a position which he held until his retirement in 2009.<ref name=lectureseries>{{Cite web|url=https://lsa.umich.edu/stats/news-events/all-events/michael-woodroofe-lecture-series.html|title=Michael Woodroofe Lecture Series|website=University of Michigan Statistics Department|access-date=August 30, 2019}}</ref>

Woodroofe was particularly noted for his work in [[sequential analysis]] and nonlinear renewal theory, in [[Central Limit Theorem|central limit]] theory, and in [[Nonparametric statistics|nonparametric inference]] with shape constraints.<ref name=conversations />  <!-- this could be expanded -->

Woodroofe advised over 40 graduate students,<ref name=conversations>{{Cite journal|author1-link=Moulinath Banerjee|last1=Banerjee|first1=Moulinath|author2-link=Bodhisattva Sen|last2=Sen|first2=Bodhisattva|year=2016|title=A conversation with Michael Woodroofe|url=https://projecteuclid.org/download/pdfview_1/euclid.ss/1475001237|journal=Statist. Sci.|volume=31|issue=3|pages=433–441|doi=10.1214/15-STS545|mr=3552743|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref name=cv>{{Cite web|url=http://dept.stat.lsa.umich.edu/~michaelw/lngvita.pdf|title=Michael Woodroofe's Curriculum Vita (dated 2006)|website=Michael Woodroofe's home page |access-date=September 4, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=7896|title=Michael Barrett Woodroofe}}</ref> many of whom have gone on to distinguished careers of their own.  He published over 100 research articles, and 2 books.  He served as editor of the ''[[Annals of Statistics]]'' from 1992 to 1994, and was the last solo editor of the journal.<ref name=conversations />

==Personal life==
Woodroofe died on February 22, 2022, at the age of 81.<ref name="umichdeathnotice">{{cite web|url=https://lsa.umich.edu/stats/news-events/all-news/facultynews/remembering-michael-woodroofe.html|title=Remembering Michael Woodroofe|publisher=University of Michigan|website=Department of Statistics|date=March 1, 2022|access-date=March 2, 2022}}</ref><ref name="Michael_Woodroofe_Formal_Obituary.pdf">{{cite web |title=Michael_Woodroofe_Formal_Obituary.pdf |url=https://lsa.umich.edu/content/dam/stats-assets/StatsPDF/Michael_Woodroofe_Formal_Obituary.pdf |website=[[University of Michigan]] |access-date=2 May 2022}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
* The ''Michael Woodroofe Lecture Series'' was established in 2008 by the University of Michigan Department of Statistics in recognition of Woodroofe's contributions.<ref name=lectureseries />
* A ''Conference on Nonparametric Inference and Probability with Applications to Science'' was held in 2005 to honor Woodroofe's career on the occasion of his 65th birthday.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://bulletin.imstat.org/wp-content/uploads/Bulletin34_7.pdf|title=More IMS Meetings Around The World|magazine=IMS Bulletin|publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics|volume=34|number=7|page=22}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Recent developments in nonparametric inference and probability|date=2006|editor1-last=Sun|editor1-first= Jiayang|editor1-link=Jiayang Sun|editor2-last=DasGupta|editor2-first=Anirban|editor3-last=Melfi|editor3-first=Vince|editor4-last=Page|editor4-first=Connie|mr=2404082|publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics|series=Institute of Mathematical Statistics Lecture Notes - Monograph Series|volume=50|url=https://projecteuclid.org/DPubS?service=UI&version=1.0&verb=Display&page=toc&handle=euclid.lnms/1196284044|access-date=September 28, 2019}}</ref>
* Woodroofe was a [[fellow]] of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].<ref name=conversations /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/|title=Honored IMS Fellows|website=Institute of Mathematical Statistics webpage|access-date=September 28, 2019}}</ref>
